question: Who is considered as the highest law officer in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Attorney General of India**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Attorney General of India:**

 
 
• The **Attorney General of India** is considered the highest law officer in the country.
 
• Appointed under **Article 76** of the Indian Constitution, the Attorney General serves as the chief legal advisor to the Government of India.
 
• They have the right to participate in proceedings of both Houses of Parliament but cannot vote.
 
• The Attorney General represents the government in important legal matters and provides legal opinions on critical issues.
 
• The position requires the individual to be qualified to be a judge of the Supreme Court of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Election Commissioner:**

 
 
• The **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)** heads the Election Commission of India, an autonomous constitutional body.
 
• The CEC is responsible for conducting free and fair elections in India, including Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and state legislative assemblies.
 
• The position is established under **Article 324** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The CEC ensures the implementation of the Model Code of Conduct and oversees electoral disputes.
 
• While the CEC holds a significant constitutional position, it is not related to legal advisory or law enforcement.
 
 
 
• **Chairman of NITI AAYOG:**
 
 
• The **Chairman of NITI AAYOG** is the head of the National Institution for Transforming India, a policy think tank established in 2015.
 
• The Prime Minister of India serves as the ex-officio Chairman of NITI AAYOG.
 
• NITI AAYOG focuses on formulating policies and strategies for India's economic and social development.
 
• It replaces the Planning Commission and emphasizes cooperative federalism and sustainable development.
 
• The Chairman of NITI AAYOG does not hold any legal or judicial authority.
 
 
 
• **Chief Justice of India:**
 
 
• The **Chief Justice of India (CJI)** is the head of the judiciary and the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The CJI is responsible for the administration of the judiciary and the allocation of cases to judges.
 
• Appointed by the President of India, the CJI is the highest judicial authority in the country.
 
• The CJI plays a crucial role in upholding the Constitution and ensuring justice.
 
• While the CJI is the highest judicial officer, the Attorney General is the highest law officer representing the government.
